  <button type=""button"" class=""play-btn"" id=""play-word"">▶</button>

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();
</script>"	"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();

          return true;

      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];

    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();
</script>"	"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });

    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

      es.className = 'ex-es';

      btn.textContent = '▶';

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);

      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }

    cg.appendChild(c2);

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {

    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"
