<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();

  if (!raw) return;

  var items = [];

    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);

    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();
</script>"	"

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

  var api = getAnkiApi();

          r.then(function (res) {

              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;

    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];

        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }

    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }

        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });

    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;

        speakEs(it.es);

      row.appendChild(btn);

      card.appendChild(pl);

          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}

    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {

    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();

  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {

        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });

  }

    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');

      btn.type = 'button';

      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {

      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;

    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

Mój sąsiad jest bardzo hojny i zawsze pomaga temu, kto tego potrzebuje.</div>
<div id=""meanings-out""></div>



<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

Nie rozumiem głównego powodu jego decyzji.

2. fabuła, treść filmu lub książki
El argumento de la película parece sencillo, pero tiene un final inesperado.
Fabuła filmu wydaje się prosta, ale ma nieoczekiwane zakończenie.</div>
<div id=""meanings-out""></div>



<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');

<script>
var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('play-word');
  var word = document.getElementById('es-word');
  if (!btn || !word) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);
  });
})();

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;

    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();

    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {

    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    speakEs(word.textContent);

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;

    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }

    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);

})();

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
</script>"

var _ankiApi = null;
function getAnkiApi() {
  if (_ankiApi) return _ankiApi;
  try {
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'undefined') return null;
    if (typeof AnkiDroidJS === 'function') {
      _ankiApi = new AnkiDroidJS({ version: '0.0.3', developer: 'local@anki.es' });
      return _ankiApi;
    }
    return AnkiDroidJS;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

function speakEs(text) {
  text = (text || '').trim();
  if (!text) return false;

  var api = getAnkiApi();
  if (api && api.ankiTtsSpeak) {
    try {
      if (api.ankiTtsStop) api.ankiTtsStop();
      var speak = function () { api.ankiTtsSpeak(text); };
      if (api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
        var r = api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es-ES');
        if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') {
          r.then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.success === false && api.ankiTtsSetLanguage) {
              return api.ankiTtsSetLanguage('es').then(speak);
            }
            speak();
          }).catch(speak);
          return true;
        }
      }
      speak();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'es-ES';
    var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
      if ((voices[i].lang || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('es') === 0) {
        u.voice = voices[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

(function () {
  var rawEl = document.getElementById('meanings-raw');
  var out = document.getElementById('meanings-out');
  if (!rawEl || !out) return;

  var raw = (rawEl.textContent || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return;

  var blocks = raw.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function (b) { return b.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var items = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (block) {
    var lines = block.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    items.push({
      polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
      es: lines[1] || '',
      pl: lines[2] || ''
    });
  });
  if (!items.length) {
    var lines = raw.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length) {
      items.push({
        polish: lines[0].replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, ''),
        es: lines[1] || '',
        pl: lines[2] || ''
      });
    }
  }

  out.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'meaning-card';

    var title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'meaning-title';
    title.textContent = it.polish;
    card.appendChild(title);

    if (it.es) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ex-es-row';

      var es = document.createElement('div');
      es.className = 'ex-es';
      es.textContent = it.es;

      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'play-btn';
      btn.textContent = '▶';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        speakEs(it.es);
      });

      row.appendChild(es);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      card.appendChild(row);
    }

    if (it.pl) {
      var pl = document.createElement('div');
      pl.className = 'ex-pl';
      pl.textContent = it.pl;
      card.appendChild(pl);
    }

    out.appendChild(card);
  });

  var tables = document.querySelectorAll('.conj table, .card table');
  tables.forEach(function (table) {
    if (table.querySelector('colgroup')) return;
    var hasPron = !!table.querySelector('td.pron');
    var hasLabel = !!table.querySelector('td.label');
    if (!hasPron && !hasLabel) return;
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    var c1 = document.createElement('col');
    var c2 = document.createElement('col');
    if (hasPron) { c1.style.width = '22%'; c2.style.width = '78%'; }
    else { c1.style.width = '42%'; c2.style.width = '58%'; }
    cg.appendChild(c1);
    cg.appendChild(c2);
    table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
  });
})();
